name: Blount Disease / Tibia Vara
definition: Pathological varus deformity of the proximal tibia due to disordered medial proximal tibial growth, occurring in infantile or adolescent forms.

redFlags.item: Neurological or metabolic bone disease features

investigations.principle: Standing lower-limb radiographs quantify metaphyseal-diaphyseal angle and deformity.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, physeal, occult injury, deformity or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

green: Bracing in selected early infantile disease
amber: Progressive or advanced deformity may require guided growth or osteotomy.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Janu/Jangha growth deformity may be documented only in parallel.

patientEducation.summary: Pathological varus deformity of the proximal tibia due to disordered medial proximal tibial growth, occurring in infantile or adolescent forms.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, open injury, severe deformity, rapidly progressive neurological symptoms, suspected infection or other listed red flags.
